lesson.title: Two Wi-Fi networks fight
lesson.goal: LobbyAP and HallAP sit on channels that overlap. Move one to 6 or 11 so the warning clears.

step.text: Open LobbyAP, Wireless tab. The Radio row shows channel 1 and warns about HallAP.
2.4 GHz channels 1, 6 and 11 do not overlap. Channels 1 and 3 interfere.
Change HallAP to channel 6 or 11, then check LobbyAP again.
